name: Release v1.5.8
body:
## What's Changed
* Lock the bundle against the release that just shipped, not uv's cached index by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/804
* Add Carbon-A gene annotation as a remote tool, and its benchmark genomes by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/805
* Let a hosting service say where its users add a missing login by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/806
* Add a ToolUniverse Connect guide skill by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/810
* Give the short ToolUniverse Connect address in the connect guide by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/811
* Stop a workspace profile.yaml from turning load_tools(categories=...) into a no-op by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/812
* Let a caller say whether load_tools() replaces what is loaded or adds to it by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/813
* Add 29 model providers on the resident remote-tool standard, each held to a byte-equivalence gate by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/809
* Fix sign-conditioned nominal p-values in GSEA_prerank by @starvingarc in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/819
* Remove the stale devtu-remote-provider copy now that the harness one is pushed by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/820
* Orange Book: return patents and exclusivity instead of a download link by @CyberNativeAI in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/794
* Avoid classifying scientific token errors as authentication failures by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/818
* Fix: FDA label tools can select a product's route and name a label's other sections by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/807
* Add protein alpha and Ile/Thr beta stereochemistry checks by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/800
* Add pH linkage postprocessing, campaign skills and a TNF exploration blog by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/815
* Add offline pKAI side-chain pKa diagnostics by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/808
* Fix: MAGICapp_list_guidelines reaches the whole public catalogue and searches it by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/821
* Fix: ~300 tools returned part of a result as if it were all of it by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/824
* Fix: SAbDab_search_structures searches by antigen again by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/826
* CI regenerates the SDK before pytest, so the generated-file tests cannot fail by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/823
* Fix main: regenerate the 713 wrapper hashes #824 left behind by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/828
* Docs: the harness mistake list is 67, and that number keeps moving by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/827
* Add RFD4-Proteina (seven protein-design tasks) via the hosted NVIDIA NIM by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/829
* The provider pool reads memory per machine and costs from the manifests by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/830
* Hold RFD4-Proteina resident behind one MCP tool by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/831
* The pool measures a model where it is loaded, and a prewarm loads it by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/832
* The provider counts in the pool's docs are the ones a reader can reproduce by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/833
* Hold BioEmu-2 resident behind one MCP tool by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/834
* Install the packages that exist on the runner we are given by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/837
* Every LOVD call fails on a parameter the caller never sent by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/840
* Make the weekly sweep and the wheel smoke test say what is actually wrong by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/839
* Release tooluniverse 1.5.8 by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/838

## New Contributors
* @CyberNativeAI made their first contribution in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/794

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/compare/v1.5.7...v1.5.8

name: Release v1.5.7
body:
## What's Changed
* Fix: an interrupted self-update broke the Desktop bundle's launch by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/759
* Add bounded PDB inventory and coincident-coordinate diagnostics by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/757
* Fix: the tool index lost its final newline on every build by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/760
* Close skill/tool gaps vs. the life-sciences tool marketplace and beyond, plus a new protocols.io tool by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/606
* Feature: reproduction code for the published benchmark results by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/538
* Add a BixBench reproduction package under benchmarks/ by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/510
* Add protein input diagnostics for MSA, SEQRES and PDB LINK records by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/761
* Report SEQRES declarations and coordinate-only PDB inputs by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/762
* Add local distance audit for explicit PDB LINK connections by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/763
* Complete PROPKA partner comparisons with retained components and carboxylates by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/765
* Retain explicitly selected components in free-partner PROPKA comparisons by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/764
* Add protein design campaign skill and correct pH validation guidance by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/766
* FDA_get_drug_label: find labels openFDA never linked (osimertinib/Tagrisso) by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/767
* Fix: re-pin Genomic Intelligence predict_expression after upstream description change by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/770
* Harden administrator-only Docker LLM provisioning by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/422
* Add safe explicit Verified Source Directory core by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/413
* Expose AgenticTool prompts and add scientific peer-review skill by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/435
* Fix: say the iPTMnet API is down and name working PTM alternatives by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/771
* Skills that let the assistant share, publish and set up logins for the user by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/772
* Fix: PubMed_convert_article_ids failed on current Python builds (PMC 403) by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/773
* Monarch searches keep items: [] when nothing matches by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/774
* DDBJ reads the organism of BioProject records by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/775
* GWAS: move SNP-by-gene and trait-name lookup off the retired v1 API by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/776
* MediaDive_get_ingredient describes its usage counts correctly by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/777
* SABIO-RK and BRENDA kinetics return the measured Km/kcat/Ki values by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/778
* load_tools(categories=...) no longer returns tools from other categories by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/779
* Bring the opt-in live test tier up to date with current tool contracts by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/780
* Live-tier tests follow the GWAS v2 and SABIO-RK Json changes by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/782
* Make sharing work when an assistant runs it: --detach, and skills from a real run by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/781
* Add EWAS Atlas tools as the EWAS fallback while the EWAS Catalog is down by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/783
* HTTP errors quote the service's reason, not its HTML error page by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/784
* Fix #787: move USGS water tools to the Water Data OGC API by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/790
* Add RFdiffusion2 as a validated remote tool by @krudo-taco in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/768
* Link CCB workshop under Workshops and Education by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/793
* OpenFDA_search_drug_labels: guide retries when a label has no openFDA fields by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/792
* Add a GEANT4 depth-dose simulation tool (closes #252) by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/796
* Fix: a tool needing any one API key gave network advice, and hid one of the keys by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/795
* Refresh the tool hash #792 left stale by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/797
* fix: keep DESeq2 and enrichGO result CSVs after R exits by @starvingarc in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/791
* Reject gross protein backbone defects before PROPKA prediction by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/785
* Add local protein sequence and structure similarity tools by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/786
* Fix: clinical guideline searches that failed, timed out or never searched by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/788
* Feature: StatPearls, LactMed and LiverTox from a local NCBI Bookshelf index, and case report search by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/789
* Treat the R tools' arguments as data, not as R code by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/798
* Let a gated tool be unlocked by the keys its error names by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/799
* Ship every data file in the wheel, not just the directories named one by one by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/801
* Release tooluniverse 1.5.7 by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/803


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/compare/v1.5.6...v1.5.7

name: Release v1.5.6
body:
## What's Changed
* Call the account key a "connection key", as the website now does by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/751
* Say "tool run limit": the platform now counts only tool runs by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/752
* Fix: error results were cached and replayed on later calls by @Om-singhaI in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/754
* Fix custom PDB uploads for ProteinsPlus ProtoSS by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/749
* Add local PROPKA pKa prediction and partner comparisons by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/750
* Fix: the other places a failure was cached, after #753 by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/755
* Fix: a failed lookup was reported as "not found", and OpenAIRE errors as success by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/756
* Release tooluniverse 1.5.6 by @gasvn in https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/pull/758


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mims-harvard/ToolUniverse/compare/v1.5.5...v1.5.6
